chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 149: Xiao Chen Breaks Through to Ninth Heaven
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen faces Wu Xingfeng's Five Elements Divine Arts in a desperate duel, only to shatter his limits and ascend to the Mortal-Shedding Ninth Heaven in a blaze of glory.
og_title: Xiao Chen's Ninth Heaven Breakthrough in World of Immortality
og_description: In a life-or-death clash, Xiao Chen uses all Four Killing Hands but is overwhelmed—until the pressure forces a breakthrough to the Ninth Heaven.
twitter_description: Xiao Chen breaks through to the Ninth Heaven of Mortal-Shedding after a brutal battle with Wu Xingfeng.
